title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
locator: peer messages / paragraph following the 'piece' message
claim: Spec text: downloaders generally download pieces in random order, which does a reasonably good job of keeping them from having a strict subset or superset of the pieces of any of their peers
conditions: de-facto guidance; spec does not mandate rarest-first or any specific picker
limitations: descriptive not normative; no rarest-first requirement anywhere in BEP 3

title: The BitTorrent Protocol Specification
locator: peer protocol / 'Connections start out choked and not interested' 之后一段
claim: Spec text: when data is transferred downloaders should keep several piece requests queued at once for good TCP performance (this is called pipelining); requests that cannot be written into the TCP send buffer immediately should be queued in memory rather than kept in an application-level network buffer so they can all be discarded when a choke happens
limitations: no numeric window size given; left implementation-defined
